vx_warp_affine — VX geometry op

• Data kinds: image2d × matrix → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vx_warp_affine(image, matrix, *, interpolation, border, constant_value=0) (to call the implementation directly, import vxcore; vxcore.vx_warp_affine(image, matrix, *, interpolation, border, constant_value=0); from the registry, opsvx.get("vx_warp_affine"))

Usage

Affine transform (Section 3.56). Inverse mapping: output pixel (x, y) is taken from input (x0, y0) (REQ-0498): x0 = M[0,0]·x + M[0,1]·y + M[0,2], y0 = M[1,0]·x + M[1,1]·y + M[1,2].

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

*matrix*: 数学の並びの 2×3(1 行目が x0 の係数 a, b, c)。★規格の C の宣言は mat[3][2] = { {a,d}, {b,e}, {c,f} } (転置した並び)—— C の配列をそのまま渡すと形が (3, 2) になるので止める。*interpolation*(必須): "nearest" / "bilinear"。*border*(必須): "constant"(*constant_value* で埋める)/ "undefined"(0 で埋める、値は規格上未定義)。

Raises ValueError: U8 の 2-D でない / matrix が 2×3 の有限でない / interpolation・border が一覧に無い。
